get.summary: Whether the AI assistant is available to the user (ai.use)
get.description: Resolves the provider from the company's settings, then the server's SERK_AI_* variables. Requires the ai.use permission and the ai_assistant module switch.

200.description: Availability. A missing or invalid provider configuration is reported as available=false with a reason, not as an error.

403.description: No ai.use permission, the AI assistant module is off, or no access to the company. Codes: `permission_denied`, `company_access_denied`.

503.description: The stored company key cannot be decrypted with this server's encryption key. Codes: `assistant_key_unreadable`.

post.summary: Ask the AI assistant; it answers from the books and may create DRAFTS only
post.description: Runs a bounded tool-use loop (at most 8 model calls, 6 tools per call, 24 KiB per tool result, 140 s). Every tool runs in its own transaction as the signed-in user, so RLS, branch scope, permissions and module switches apply. Draft tools create DRAFT journals, sales invoices and supplier bills; nothing is submitted, approved, posted, paid, reversed or voided. Rate limit: 12 requests per minute per session.

200.description: The reply, the tools used and any drafts created.

400.description: Malformed body or conversation (empty, more than 30 messages, a message over 8000 bytes, roles not alternating, not starting and ending with user, invalid screen). Codes: `invalid_json`, `invalid_request`, `company_id_required`.

403.description: No ai.use permission, the AI assistant module is off, or CSRF failed. Codes: `permission_denied`, `csrf_required`, `invalid_csrf`, `company_access_denied`.

429.description: More than 12 chat requests per minute in this session. Codes: `rate_limited`.

500.description: Unexpected failure during the conversation. Any drafts already saved are listed. Code: `internal_error`.

502.description: The AI service rejected the key or the request, redirected, or returned an oversized or unreadable response. Codes: `assistant_key_rejected`, `assistant_request_rejected`, `assistant_redirect_refused`, `assistant_response_too_large`, `assistant_unavailable`. Drafts already saved are listed.

503.description: No provider configured, invalid configuration, unreadable stored key, provider rate limit or provider unavailable. Codes: `assistant_not_configured`, `assistant_misconfigured`, `assistant_key_unreadable` (plain Error body); `assistant_rate_limited`, `assistant_unavailable` (with drafts and steps).

504.description: The conversation exceeded 140 s. Code: `assistant_timeout`. Drafts already saved are listed.

get.summary: Company AI provider settings (configuration.manage); the key is never returned

200.description: The company's settings, or null when it uses the server's settings or none.

post.summary: Set the company AI provider, model, address and key (company-wide configuration.manage, audited)
post.description: The API key is sealed with AES-GCM (the installation's SERK_MFA_KEY) and bound to the company before it is stored outside the audit trail. A stored key is only used with the provider and base URL it was entered for.

200.description: The saved settings.

403.description: Requires company-wide configuration.manage, or CSRF failed. Codes: `permission_denied`, `csrf_required`, `invalid_csrf`, `company_access_denied`.

422.description: Invalid settings. assistant_key_required: the provider or base_url changed while a key is stored; enter the key again or set clear_key. Codes: `invalid_request`, `invalid_base_url`, `invalid_api_key`, `invalid_reason`, `assistant_key_required`.

503.description: The server has no 32-byte encryption key, so a key cannot be stored. Codes: `assistant_key_storage_unavailable`.

SessionCookie.name: __Host-serk_session
SessionCookie.description: Staging and production secure host-only session cookie.

DevelopmentSessionCookie.name: serk_session
DevelopmentSessionCookie.description: Loopback development mode and office installations (plain HTTP inside the office).

Minor.description: Nonnegative exact integer minor units; not a JSON number

field.description: Present when the error concerns one input field (for example asset_account_id or receivable). A field key, never a data value.

Journal.description: Journal responses may contain up to 501 lines: 2–500 supplied source lines plus one is_rounding=true functional-only line. Exact monetary values are strings. Request bodies cannot supply system lines.

code.description: Required for enrolled users and all staging/production logins; single-use TOTP code.

branch_id.description: Omit or null for all branches

approval_limit_minor.description: Only for roles with journal.approve. Null means no limit; it can never exceed your own limit.

expected_version.description: Required for update; omit for create

configured_by.description: Whether the company's own settings or the server's SERK_AI_* variables are in use.

content.description: Plain text, at most 8000 bytes after trimming.

messages.description: The conversation so far. Roles alternate, starting and ending with user.

screen.description: What the user is looking at, for context (for example "journal JRN-EFY2019-000003").

note.description: Error code when the tool failed.

AssistantDraft.description: A DRAFT the assistant created as the signed-in user. It still needs review, submission and independent approval.

field.description: Present when the error concerns one input field (for example asset_account_id or receivable). A field key, never a data value.

drafts.description: Drafts already saved before the failure.

AssistantSettings.description: null when the company has no settings of its own.

key_set.description: Whether an API key is stored. The key itself is never returned.

provider.description: openai means any OpenAI-compatible Chat Completions server.

base_url.description: Required for openai. HTTPS, or plain HTTP to localhost/loopback (private addresses only when the server sets SERK_AI_ALLOW_PRIVATE_HTTP=true). No credentials, query or fragment.

api_key.description: Omit or leave empty to keep the stored key. Sealed with AES-GCM and bound to the company; never returned. Required again when provider or base_url changes while a key is stored.

clear_key.description: Remove the stored key. Not together with api_key.
